description: This class serves as a facade for authentication-related operations, providing methods to access the current Authentication object and the authenticated User entity within a Spring Security context.

classes.name: AuthenticationFacade
classes.description: A Spring component providing methods to retrieve the current Authentication object and the authenticated User based on email.

methods.name: getAuthentication
methods.description: Returns the current Authentication object from Spring Security context.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedUser
methods.description: Fetches the authenticated User entity using the email obtained from the Authentication object.
